headline: UNC coordinator uncertainty and TCU absences remain material
detail: UNC QB Billy Edwards Jr. is confirmed as the starter, but defensive coordinator Steve Belichick remains on medical leave. TCU projected starting safety Jacob Fields was dismissed before the opener, and WR Dozie Ezukanma is out.
modelTreatment: No additional fair-line adjustment beyond the existing TCU -7 assessment.

headline: Wet-weather concern active in Dublin
detail: Rain/wet-field risk remains around Aviva Stadium with light wind.
modelTreatment: No numerical weather adjustment locked in.

headline: UNC +9.5 remained the preferred late entry
detail: The portal fair line remained TCU -7 immediately before kickoff while late same-day reporting showed TCU -9.5.
impact: Roughly 2.5 points of UNC value at the best late number
modelTreatment: +9 or better was the preferred executable threshold before kickoff.

headline: USC absences remain, while San Jose State QB is settled
detail: Projected USC starting center Kilian O'Connor is out for the season and DL Jahkeem Stewart remains out for the opener. San Jose State will start Hawaii transfer Luke Weaver at quarterback.
impact: Small USC negative from absences; reduced SJSU QB uncertainty
modelTreatment: No separate fair-line move; current USC -40.5 assessment already reflects the broader matchup view.

headline: USC price improves into the portal's value zone
detail: Action Network live odds are around USC -38.5, with Fanatics around -39, versus the portal's USC -40.5 fair line. The total has risen to roughly 61-61.5.
impact: Creates roughly 1.5-2 points of USC spread value while removing the prior Over edge
modelTreatment: Promote USC side to conviction-stage/high-priority. Do not auto-execute because five-touchdown spreads carry elevated variance and USC still has meaningful absences.

headline: Hot but otherwise benign conditions

modelTreatment: No numerical adjustment.

headline: Both teams carry broad absence lists
detail: NC State is listed without Isaiah Crowell, Teddy Hoffmann, Gus Ritchey, Rylan Vann, Tyreek Copper, Carmelo McKenzie and JJ Ferguson Jr. Virginia also has a broad absence list, with Corey Costner and Kam Robinson questionable.
impact: Depth uncertainty is significant on both sides
modelTreatment: Fair line remains Virginia -3 pending any final late status confirmations.

headline: NC State side edge compresses to about one point

impact: Side remains below preferred threshold; total retains a numerical Over gap
modelTreatment: No side promotion. Keep total research-only because absences and expert Under support conflict with the raw model gap.
